name: mxroute
description: Manage MXroute email hosting: domains, mailboxes, forwarders, spam filtering, DNS and quota. Needs the mxroute-mcp binary on PATH; install it from https://github.com/sshine/mxroute-rs/releases or with nix profile install github:sshine/mxroute-rs#mxroute-mcp.

server.title: Mail server hostname
server.description: The MXroute server the account lives on, such as eagle.mxlogin.com.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://panel.mxroute.com/api-keys.php. Stored in the OS keychain, not in a settings file.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes
allow_writes.description: Off, only the tools that read anything are served. On, adds the tools that create, change and delete domains, mailboxes, forwarders and spam entries.

reseller.title: Reseller account
reseller.description: On, adds the tools for managing reseller users and packages. These endpoints exist only on a reseller account.
